name: vscode-utplsql
description: Run utPLSQL (Oracle PL/SQL) tests from the VS Code Test Explorer, with context menus and visual coverage (pytest-style).
author: Gil Cleber Barboza

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Connection profiles point to a database and the password is kept in SecretStorage; the extension stays disabled until the workspace is trusted (Workspaces: Trust).

utplsql.profiles.markdownDescription: Saved Oracle connection profiles to switch quickly between environments (DEV, TEST, PROD). Each profile can override `connection`, `sourcePath`, `coverageOwner`, etc. The **password is stored in SecretStorage** (VS Code keychain), not in plain text in the settings.

description.description: Friendly description shown in the connection picker.

charset.description: Encoding used to read script files (runScriptFile/runScriptFolder). Omitted = utf8.

walletLocation.description: Oracle Cloud wallet location (thin), e.g. /path/to/wallet. The wallet password is kept in SecretStorage — use the command "utPLSQL: Set wallet password".

utplsql.activeProfile.markdownDescription: ID of the active connection profile (`utplsql.profiles`). When set, it overrides `utplsql.connection`.

utplsql.connection.markdownDescription: Oracle connection string (`user/password@//host:port/service`). If empty, it uses the `UTPLSQL_CONN` environment variable; if still empty, the extension asks for it (and keeps it only for the session). **Recommended to leave it empty and use the environment variable** so the password is not written to the settings.

utplsql.sourcePath.description: Folder (relative to the workspace root) with the production code. Used in the -source_path argument to map coverage to local files.

utplsql.includePatterns.description: Globs used to discover the test specs that contain the `%suite`/`%test` annotations.

utplsql.coverageOwner.description: Schema that owns the objects for coverage mapping. If empty, it uses the connection user (the part before '/'), uppercased.

utplsql.coverage.schemes.description: Covered schemas (`a_coverage_schemes`). Empty uses the connection user (or `utplsql.coverageOwner`).

utplsql.coverage.includeObjects.description: Objects to include in coverage, in the `OWNER.NAME` format (e.g. ["APP.MY_PKG"]). Useful for objects reached only dynamically.

utplsql.coverage.excludeObjects.description: Objects to exclude from coverage, in the `OWNER.NAME` format (e.g. ["UT3.UT_COVERAGE"]).

utplsql.coverage.includeSchemaExpr.description: Regular expression of schemas to include in coverage (e.g. "^APP$").

utplsql.coverage.includeObjectExpr.description: Regular expression of objects to include in coverage.

utplsql.coverage.excludeSchemaExpr.description: Regular expression of schemas to exclude from coverage.

utplsql.coverage.excludeObjectExpr.description: Regular expression of objects to exclude from coverage (e.g. "^UT_" for the utPLSQL framework).

utplsql.timeoutMinutes.description: Timeout of a test run, in minutes. When it expires, the run is cancelled.

utplsql.dbmsOutput.description: Captures the DBMS_OUTPUT of the test session and appends it to the run output. Useful for debugging.

utplsql.additionalReporters.description: Additional reporters to include on every run (e.g. ["ut_coverage_html_reporter"]). The default reporters (documentation, junit and coverage) are always included.

utplsql.reporter.clientCharacterSet.description: Client charset for the reporter export (`a_client_character_set` argument). Empty uses the reporter default.

utplsql.reporter.colorConsole.description: Enables ANSI color in the output of textual console reporters in the export (`a_color_console` argument).

utplsql.tags.description: utPLSQL tag expression (e.g. "fast & !integration") to filter which tests run. Empty runs all.

utplsql.run.randomOrder.description: Runs the tests in random order, to reveal order dependencies between them.

utplsql.run.randomOrderSeed.description: Seed for the random order. 0 = chosen by the database (not reproducible); greater than 0 reproduces the same order.

utplsql.oraclePoolMin.description: Minimum connections kept in the Oracle runner pool (node-oracledb).

utplsql.oraclePoolMax.description: Maximum connections in the Oracle runner pool (node-oracledb).

utplsql.oraclePoolIncrement.description: Increment when expanding the Oracle runner pool (node-oracledb).

utplsql.oraclePoolPingInterval.description: Seconds between health checks of idle pool connections (node-oracledb). 0 = ping on every checkout.

enumDescriptions: Thin driver (default): pure JavaScript, no native client.
Thick driver: uses the Oracle Instant Client. Required for databases with NNE (Native Network Encryption). Requires oracleClientLibDir and a window reload.
utplsql.oracleClientMode.description: Mode of the node-oracledb driver. Thick is opt-in, because NNE is not active on every database.

utplsql.oracleClientLibDir.markdownDescription: Oracle Instant Client directory. Required when `#utplsql.oracleClientMode#` is `thick`. E.g. `C:\oracle\instantclient_23_5`.

utplsql.oracleClientConfigDir.markdownDescription: Oracle configuration directory (TNS_ADMIN) with `sqlnet.ora`/`tnsnames.ora`. Optional; only takes effect in `thick`.

utplsql.connections.tnsAdminPath.markdownDescription: Directory with `tnsnames.ora` to resolve **TNS aliases in the thin driver**. Resolution: this setting → user/machine value of `sqldeveloper.connections.tnsConfiguration.path` → `TNS_ADMIN` environment variable. Easy Connect keeps working normally.

enumDescriptions: Organizes the tests by file path (default).
Organizes the tests by Oracle schema (Schema > Package > Suite > Test). Use organization.schemaPattern to define how the schema is extracted from the path.
Organizes the tests by `%tags` (Tag > Suite > Test). Suites with multiple tags appear under each tag; those without a tag go to "(no tag)".
utplsql.organization.description: How the test tree is organized in the Test Explorer.

utplsql.organization.schemaPattern.markdownDescription: Glob pattern to extract the schema name from the file path. Use `{schema}` as the placeholder. E.g. `db/{schema}/**` extracts `APP` from `db/APP/tests/ut_foo.pks`. Only used when `#utplsql.organization#` is `schema`.

utplsql.discovery.source.markdownDescription: Source of the test tree in `schema` mode: `auto` uses the database API (`ut_runner.get_suites_info`) and falls back to `ALL_SOURCE`/files when unavailable; `database` requires the API; `file` disables database discovery.

utplsql.refreshDebounceMs.description: Debounce (ms) to coalesce .pks/.pkb file watcher events before refreshing the Test Explorer.

utplsql.codeLens.enabled.description: Shows Run/Run with Coverage CodeLens buttons over `%suite` and `%test`.

utplsql.statusBar.enabled.description: Shows the test status indicator in the status bar.

utplsql.decorations.enabled.description: Shows pass/fail decorations on the `%suite` and `%test` lines after a run.

utplsql.compilationDiagnostics.enabled.description: Shows PL/SQL compilation errors as underlines in the editor and in the Problems Panel after the tests run.

utplsql.showTagsInTree.description: Suffixes `[tag1, tag2]` to the Test Explorer item labels, according to the `%tags` declared in the suite/test.

enumDescriptions: Automatically re-runs the suites of the saved .pks file (watch mode).
utplsql.autoRun.description: Auto-run on save: re-runs the suites of the .pks file when it is saved.

utplsql.autoRunDelayMs.description: Debounce (ms) of the auto-run per file; fast saves of the same file trigger a single run.

enumDescriptions: Skips the auto-run if a run is already in progress.
Reschedules the auto-run to run after the current run.
utplsql.autoRunQueue.description: What to do when an auto-run is triggered during a run.

utplsql.setupDiagnostics.enabled.description: Shows configuration diagnostics (connection, grants, version) in the Problems Panel and offers quick-fix actions.

utplsql.sqlCoverageEnabled.markdownDescription: Enables view tracking via `V$SQL` (boolean coverage: executed = 100%, not executed = 0%). Requires `GRANT SELECT ON V$SQL` on Oracle.

utplsql.debugger.enabled.description: Enables PL/SQL test debugging support (DBMS_DEBUG). Requires node-oracledb and grants.

utplsql.debugger.stopOnException.description: Automatically pauses on PL/SQL exceptions during debugging.

utplsql.debugger.timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout (s) of the debug session to avoid zombie Oracle connections.

utplsql.debugger.compileOnDebug.description: Compiles the object with debug information (ALTER … COMPILE DEBUG) before starting the debug session.

utplsql.scriptRunner.stopOnError.description: Stops script execution on the first failure (false = keeps logging the rest).

utplsql.scriptRunner.filePattern.description: Globs to list files when running a script folder.

utplsql.scriptRunner.dbmsOutput.description: Captures and displays DBMS_OUTPUT during script execution.

utplsql.language.markdownDescription: Language of the extension's textual content. `auto` follows the VS Code language (15 native + bg, el, en-gb, id, ro, sr, th, uk, vi; otherwise en).

explorer/context.when: resourceExtname == .sql || resourceExtname == .pks || resourceExtname == .pkb || resourceExtname == .fnc || resourceExtname == .prc || resourceExtname == .trg

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.pretest:unit: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.pretest:integration: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.pretest:integration:smoke: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.pretest:integration:thick: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.pretest:integration:multiroot: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.test:coverage: npm run compile && c8 node --experimental-test-module-mocks --require ./scripts/test-setup.cjs --test out/test/unit/**/*.test.js
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run bundle && vsce package
scripts.package:win32-x64: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node scripts/package-target.cjs win32-x64
scripts.package:linux-x64: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node scripts/package-target.cjs linux-x64
scripts.package:linux-arm64: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node scripts/package-target.cjs linux-arm64
scripts.package:darwin-arm64: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node scripts/package-target.cjs darwin-arm64
scripts.brain:ci: node scripts/brain.cjs sync && node scripts/brain-build.cjs && node scripts/brain.cjs check && node scripts/brain-rules.cjs && node scripts/brain-gaps.cjs --warn
scripts.publish:patch: echo '⚠️ Publicacao apenas via GitHub workflow (release). Use npm run package para .vsix local.' && exit 1
